name: Mithuna
personality: Curious, intelligent, adaptable, expressive, quick-witted, and sociable.
relationships: Friendly, expressive, and intellectually driven. Prefers communication and companionship in relationships.
health: Shoulders, arms, lungs, nervous system, respiratory issues.
description: Mithuna is the third sign of the zodiac, representing intellect, communication, curiosity, and versatility. Ruled by Mercury, it symbolizes learning, adaptability, social interaction, and the constant pursuit of knowledge.
